'''Aquilaris Minor''', or simply '''Aquilaris''', was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].

==Description==
[[File:Aquilaris_sithwar.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Aquilaris during the [[New Sith Wars]].]]

Aquilaris Minor was a predominantly [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] [[Planet/Legends|world]], though it had some landmass. Its oceans were rich in marine flora and fauna including [[Algae/Legends|algae]] and [[Eel/Legends|eels]] which were harvested as food by members of the [[Seacroppers' Guild]].<ref name="SWKE6">[[Knight Errant: Deluge 1|''Knight Errant: Deluge'' 1]]</ref> Much of its surface landmass was flat with no high [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] ranges. Known terrain included equatorial beaches and polar fjords.<ref name="TEAE" /> Its landmass also included at least one chain of islands near [[Capital Cay]]. The highest known point on Aquilaris was [[Tarrah Hill]], which was even pregnable to flooding.<ref name="SWKE9">[[Knight Errant: Deluge 4|''Knight Errant: Deluge'' 4]]</ref>

The planet's main [[City/Legends|city]] Capital Cay served as a key seaside port with a large fleet of [[Seacropper Submersible]]s and boats. Capital Cay also boasted at least one [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] for interstellar traffic.<ref name="SWKE7">[[Knight Errant: Deluge 2|''Knight Errant: Deluge'' 2]]</ref> Due to its flat landmass and large oceans, the planet's landmass was vulnerable to global flooding. During the [[Aquilaris campaign]], a fleet of [[Stormdriver]]s equipped with weaponized vaporators created a global flood which inundated much of Aquilaris' surface landmass.<ref name="SWKE9" />

==History==
Between [[3701 BBY]] and [[3699 BBY]], the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] of [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] was charted through Aquilaris as part of the [[Seswenna Expansion]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> During or after this period, the planet joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and opened itself as a major resort world and exporter of seafood.<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="SWKE6" /> While the Republic kept a foothold in the Grumani sector, the [[New Sith Wars]] threatened to tear the sector apart. Accepting refugees from abroad, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Vannar Treece]] led the resistance on this world before it [[Massacre of Aquilaris|fell]] to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Chagras Hegemony]] in [[1042 BBY]].<ref name="TEAE" />

Following the death of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Chagras]], his empire collapsed into several pocket states. Aquilaris was subsequently ruled by several different Sith Lords and its people suffered much poverty and deprivation under their rule. By [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], the planet had been incorporated into Lord [[Daiman]]'s princedom known as the [[Daimanate]]. His policies included exploiting Aquilaris as a source of seafood to feed his military forces, which led to severe hardship among the Aquilarians. As with his other subject worlds, Daiman built large statues and [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] [[Holoprojector/Legends|projectors]] depicting himself to maintain his ideological grip over the planet.<ref name="SWKE6" />

[[File:Aquilaris_battle.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The [[Aquilaris campaign]].]]

The Republic's [[Grace Command]] led by [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Lemayne]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] ran a top-secret operation which involved distributing the addictive [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Deluge]] to Sith-occupied space including Aquilaris. While it succeeded in weakening the Sith military forces without committing substantial Republic resources, the spice disrupted the lives of many Aquilarians who became addicts.<ref name="SWKE8">[[Knight Errant: Deluge 3|''Knight Errant: Deluge'' 3]]</ref> Following a [[Battle of Capital Cay|three-way battle]] at Capital Cay, the Daimanate garrison was overwhelmed by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] forces under [[Zodoh]] and Grace Command's [[Devil Squadron]]. Meanwhile, the Jedi Knight [[Kerra Holt]] infiltrated her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] after receiving a distress call from the Seacroppers' Guild. She subsequently established contact with Devil Squadron and assisted in mopping-up operations against Daiman's Sith forces.<ref name="SWKE6" />

While Grace Command was welcomed as liberators by the local population and delivered much needed food and medical relief supplies, they secretly distributed more stocks of Deluge spice. Their modus operandi involved departing from Aquilaris and then allowing Sith forces to recapture the planet, thus spreading the addiction.<ref name="SWKE8" /> However, Devil Squadron was ambushed and captured by Zodoh following a [[Capture of Devil Squadron|dogfight]] in the [[Aquilaris Minor system/Legends|Aquilaris Minor system]]. Meanwhile, Zodoh had deployed a fleet of [[Stormdriver]]s, capital ships capable of generating artificial floods. He intended to flood Aquilaris' surface as a means of intimidating the local Sith lords.<ref name="SWKE7" />

Zodoh forced Devil Squadron's [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jenn Devaad]] to bring back the remaining stocks of Deluge spice on Aquilaris. He planned to synthesize his own stock and then lace food supplies with the spice to weaken resistance in the Grumani sector. However, his scheme was sabotaged by Devaad who had rigged their containers with explosives. The ensuing explosion allowed her to escape and disrupted the Stormdrivers' artificial storms and floods on Aquilaris. Meanwhile, Holt&mdash;with the assistance of local Seacroppers [[Padgett]] and [[Joad Kreel]]&mdash;managed to evacuate thousands of flood refugees to an underwater [[harvester station]]. Despite the widespread damage caused by the global flood, Aquilaris' small population meant that fewer lives were lost. Satisfied with his successful testing on Aquilaris, Zodoh dispatched his Stormdrivers to [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]], the capital of Daiman's princedom.<ref name="SWKE9" />

Following the [[Battle of Darkknell]], the floods gradually subsided and the refugees were able to gradually return to their homes. Aquilaris was saved from further Sith incursions by false intelligence that it was still completely submerged in water. With its underwater harvester stations, Aquilaris would subsequently become a major base for shuttling refugees out of Sith space into Republic territory. Following the [[Aquilaris campaign]], the flow of the Deluge spice was halted. Meanwhile, Devaad misled Grace Command with false intelligence that she had secured a contract for distributing Deluge to Aquilaris. En route, however, Devaad would arrange for the Deluge to be dumped into the space while the same transport ship would be used to ferry refugees to Republic space.<ref name="SWKE10">[[Knight Errant: Deluge 5|''Knight Errant: Deluge'' 5]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Aquilaris Minor first appeared during the [[Star Wars: Knight Errant (comic series)|''Star Wars: Knight Errant'']] comic series, making its debut during a flashback scene in [[Knight Errant 2|''Knight Errant: Aflame'' 2]] on [[November 10]], [[2010]]. The planet would then play a greater role in the plot of the [[Star Wars: Knight Errant: Deluge|''Deluge'']] story arc. Throughout the ''Knight Errant'' series, the planet has always been referred to as Aquilaris.

[[Jason Fry]] confirmed that Aquilaris Minor was invented to account for mapping discrepancies between the planet Aquilaris from [[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']] and previous sources.<ref name="Atlas">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31618818|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfy]]|date=2011-03-26|time=10:52 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20191013233754/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-163|quote=Of that list of systems, Gultanna, Manoe, Opitha Tren and Thory Prime were created for the appendix, basically for bookkeeping purposes so every sector would be associated with at least one system. The others are all established worlds.}}</ref>
